Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

fpod (development version)

  • fp_read() now counts POD minutes from 1899-12-30 (the Delphi/Excel convention used by the FPOD and CPOD apps), not 1900-01-01. All times were previously 2 days late. This change is implemented to stay consistent with the FPOD/CPOD apps.
  • fp_read() now calculates all times in UTC, and the tz argument only sets how they are displayed. The default is now tz = "UTC" (previously "", the local time zone). POD clocks have no daylight saving time, so reading them in a local time zone could add spurious one-hour shifts within a file.
  • env$minute now starts at 0, matching clicks$minute. It previously started at 1, so env rows were offset by one minute from the clicks.
  • env$pod_on is now calculated in C++ and follows the FPOD app’s logic:
    • FP1/FP3: a minute is on if the minute records on either side of it flag it as on, or if it contains clicks.
    • CP1/CP3: a minute is on if the tilt in the minute record that ends it is within the pod’s switch angle limits, if the count field of the minute record that starts it (CP3 only) is above zero, or if it contains clicks.
  • fp_summarize() now only counts minutes where the pod was on, and its minutes are aligned with click times. They were previously offset by one minute and included minutes where the pod was off.
  • F-POD battery voltages (env$bat1v, env$bat2v) are now raw values divided by 10 (units of 0.1 V, as in the FPOD app), not by 50.
  • C-POD battery columns (env$bat1v, env$bat2v, env$bat_use) are now NA. C-POD files contain no battery voltages, and these columns previously held the raw temperature and tilt values.
  • added parameter time_offset to fp_read()
  • added a time column to the “env” data.table in the list returned by fp_read()

New features

  • fp_read() gains a time_offset argument (seconds or difftime), added to all times in a file. Use it to convert the POD clock to UTC (e.g. -2 hours for a clock set to Central European summer time) and to correct known clock errors. A warning is given for plain numbers under one hour, which are likely hours given without units.
  • fp_read() adds a time column to env.
  • fp_read() adds header$switch_angle_from and header$switch_angle_to for CP1/CP3 files: the pod’s switch angle limits, as raw tilt values.
  • fp_read() now gives an error for unknown time zone names, instead of silently using UTC”
  • fp_summarize() gains an fpod_compat argument (default TRUE). With fpod_compat = TRUE, every minute from the first click in x onwards counts as on, as in the FPOD app, which stops checking a C-POD’s tilt once it has seen a click. With fpod_compat = FALSE, only minutes where the pod was on (env$pod_on) count, which excludes minutes where the pod was tilted past its switch angle. F-POD results are the same either way.

Bug fixes

  • CP1/CP3 files: records of types 251-253 are now skipped instead of being read as clicks, and reading stops at the end-of-data record (255). The last click of a file is no longer dropped.
  • CP1/CP3 files: the minute after the last minute record that the FPOD app parses is now treated as on, matching the app.
  • C-POD temperatures (env$degC) now keep their decimals (raw value / 5, as in the CPOD app). They were previously rounded to whole degrees.
  • fp_summarize(): bpm is now NA throughout when there is no buzz column. It was previously NA for minutes with clicks and 0 for minutes without.
  • fp_read() now returns tables that print on the first try after reading (they were previously suppressed by data.table after :=).

fpod 1.1.0

CRAN release: 2026-11-07

  • several improvements and extensions to fp_find_buzzes():
  • added alias “pirotta1” for method = “clicks”
  • added alias “pirotta2” for method = = “trains”
  • added two variants of the Search Buzz Feeding Identification (SBFI) method to fp_find_buzzes(), “sfbi1” and “sfbi2”
  • added method “threshold” to fp_find_buzzes(), to facilitate the use of custom thresholds for identifying buzzes.
  • refactored fp_find_buzzes() to use ICIs in units of ms (rather than decimal minutes with nanosecond precision). This improves the numerical stability of method=“pirotta2”
  • added some more examples for fp_find_buzzes()

fpod 1.0.2

CRAN release: 2026-09-14

  • fp_read() now handles empty FP3 files better to avoid crashing when reading multiple FP3 files.

fpod 1.0.1

CRAN release: 2026-05-12

  • add () behind function names in package description.

fpod v1.0.0 (development version)

  • Initial CRAN submission.
